record.name: LP performance bond
record.summary: Require actual separately funded collateral for positive LP additions, refundable or forfeitable according to held principal tenure.

units.amounts: Explicit per-field raw currency units; no currency/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual v4 liquidity L, not token balances or dollar depth
units.time: Fields distinguish absolute UTC seconds, durations, block counts and Monday UTC weekly offsets
units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96

fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1 / raw currency0); not display-token price
fields.help: Enter the raw-unit starting price. Check both token decimals before translating a display price.

fields.name: liquidityQuantum
fields.label: Liquidity Quantum
fields.units: Uniswap v4 liquidity L units; not token amounts or economic capital

fields.name: bondPerQuantum
fields.label: Bond Per Quantum
fields.units: raw bond token units; token decimals are not converted

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code and exact-transfer semantics; no tax/rebase token, decimals or backing inferred.
Must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero address validation alone is insufficient.
Must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero address validation alone is insufficient.
Router must deliberately fund the exact bond position. Actual core position identity is router/range/salt; do not imply an end-wallet refund without router semantics.

definition.help: Every addition must be an exact multiple of liquidityQuantum; bond = (added liquidity / quantum) × bondPerQuantum, not USD collateral or a rounded-up dust charge. Sixteen immature lots per position; early exit forfeits corresponding collateral, while mature lots release to owner claims. Principal exits are token-independent; bond is not pool principal or LP fees.
